title: A9 staged hybrid adoption: permission evaluator first, then singular SSOT, then gateway, lockfile, adapter, ledger, product surface — each stage a PR with a named proof gate and a git-revert rollback
question: Design the staged adoption order for the hybrid: which subsystem lands first, what each stage must PROVE before the next may begin, and what the rollback is at every stage boundary - given the binding PR-ONLY release mode, which means every stage boundary is a pull request rather than a deployment.
release_mode_anchor: command-center/WORK-UNIT-CATALOG.json owner_decisions answer PR-ONLY (OWNER-DECISIONS.md is absent on this worktree; catalog records the binding decision at the Prompt-Two release-mode row)
binding_constraint: Every stage boundary is a pull request. There is no canary deploy, no public marketplace publish, and no direct index write. Rollback is git revert of the stage PR, not an uninstall against a live host.

first_subsystem.why_first: The hybrid's distinctive risk is new entry paths (marketplace install-time, gateway activation-time, adapter dispatch-time, workflow invocation-time). If those land first they must be retrofitted through the choke. Landing A7 first makes 'register this path with the evaluator' a proof gate of every later PR. Catalog ARC-0062 enumerates those four times.

adoption_rationale: S1 A7 evaluator (singular permission). S2 A2 generated SSOT with A1 as extract-only import (A1 DESIGN is static JSON; A2 DESIGN forbids opaque passthrough — two catalogs would be a duplicate control plane). S3 A4 gateway indexes the registry, not a parallel catalog. S4 A3 lockfile packages under PR-ONLY with publish_channel null so the marketplace is not an unfalsifiable public index. S5 A6 adapter before the runtime so dispatch cannot go around untrusted-vendor handling. S6 A5 ledger folds ad-hoc rails without dropping in-flight work. S7 A8 error contract last so UX cannot paper over missing subsystems. Stacked PRs revert from the tip backward.

source_layout.notes: A9 DESIGN.json present=True. A1 DESIGN present=True. A2 DESIGN present=True. Hybrid composition for this unit is derived from catalog mechanism claims for A1-A8 and the on-tree dossiers when present; it is not a claim that ARC-0059 already shipped.

stages.mechanism: Single permission choke point: every install/activation/dispatch/workflow-invocation path must cross one evaluator (catalog ARC-0045/ARC-0062).
stages.proof_obligation: Every enumerated entry path is in evaluator.covered_paths, and the planted bypass path is reported uncovered. Artifacts: hybrid/permission-evaluator.json, hybrid/enumerated-paths.json, hybrid/planted-bypass.json.
stages.proof_predicate: set(enumerated-paths.json.paths) <= set(permission-evaluator.json.covered_paths) AND planted-bypass.json.path not in covered_paths AND planted-bypass.json.crosses_evaluator is false AND len(control-planes.json.rows)==1 AND that row.authority==permission-evaluator
rollback_commands: test "$HEAD_STAGE" = "S1" || (echo "revert later stacked PRs first; tip is not S1" && exit 1)
stages.pr_title: A9 S1: land the single permission evaluator before any new entry path
stages.must_not_introduce: a second permission evaluator or an uncovered live entry path

stages.mechanism: A2 typed registry is the sole capability-identity authority. A1 static trees are extract sources (ARC-0003 DESIGN, ARC-0007/ARC-0014 migration): live-unique remainder is queued, never a second catalog and never an opaque passthrough.
stages.proof_obligation: Registry exists; generated projections cite registry_id; load-order does not treat hybrid/a1-import/ as authority; A1 unique line is on the adjudication queue.
stages.proof_predicate: registry.json.authority==generated-ssot-registry AND generated/skill.council.json.provenance.registry_id==skill.council AND 'hybrid/a1-import/' in load-order.json.not_authority AND LIVE-ONLY-LINE:synthetic-ARC-0063-a1-remainder in adjudication-queue.json AND permission-evaluator.json byte-identical to S1
rollback_commands: test "$HEAD_STAGE" = "S2" || (echo "revert later stacked PRs first; tip is not S2" && exit 1)
stages.pr_title: A9 S2: land generated SSOT; A1 remains import-only
stages.must_not_introduce: A1 as a live second catalog or opaque_body passthrough

stages.mechanism: Gateway indexes registry ids but materializes only the selected set; resident-set floor is evaluator+index; not-selected is distinct from not-installed.
stages.proof_obligation: gateway-index ids are a subset of registry entry ids; every activation event carries a permission_ticket; nothing-selected resident set excludes generated bodies.
stages.proof_predicate: set(gateway-index.json.ids) <= set(registry entry ids) AND all(activation-log events have permission_ticket) AND skill.council in selection-state.selected AND wf.catalog-class.discovery-only in selection-state.not_selected AND mcp.missing.example in selection-state.not_installed
rollback_commands: test "$HEAD_STAGE" = "S3" || (echo "revert later stacked PRs first; tip is not S3" && exit 1)
stages.pr_title: A9 S3: land gateway activation over the registry, not a parallel catalog

stages.mechanism: Lockfile-pinned local packages under PR-ONLY: publish_channel is null. Package identity is the lockfile; capability identity stays the registry.
stages.proof_obligation: lockfile.pins sha256-match package bytes; publish_channel is JSON null; package-map values are registry ids; no public index file is written.
stages.proof_predicate: lockfile.json.publish_channel is None AND lockfile.json.release_mode==PR-ONLY AND lockfile.pins[pkg]==sha256(packages/pkg-skill-council.json) AND package-map.json[pkg-skill-council]==skill.council AND not exists(hybrid/public-index.json)
rollback_commands: test "$HEAD_STAGE" = "S4" || (echo "revert later stacked PRs first; tip is not S4" && exit 1)
stages.pr_title: A9 S4: land lockfile packages with publish_channel null (PR-ONLY)
stages.must_not_introduce: a public marketplace index or a second capability catalog

stages.mechanism: One work-unit contract with GUARANTEED/BEST-EFFORT/VENDOR-ONLY tiers; silent downgrade is refused; vendor output is untrusted; evaluator is consulted.
stages.proof_obligation: Every adapter-contract field has exactly one tier; downgrade-refusal is FAIL-LOUD; canary secret is not in the forward log; permission_ticket is present.
stages.proof_predicate: set(adapter-contract.json.fields.values()) <= {GUARANTEED,BEST-EFFORT,VENDOR-ONLY} AND each field has exactly one tier AND conformance-matrix.json.downgrade_refusal.result==FAIL-LOUD AND CANARY-SECRET not in untrusted-forward-log.json.forwarded AND untrusted-forward-log.json.permission_ticket startswith a7-single-choke
rollback_commands: test "$HEAD_STAGE" = "S5" || (echo "revert later stacked PRs first; tip is not S5" && exit 1)
stages.pr_title: A9 S5: land cross-vendor adapter with loud mismatch, no secret forward
stages.must_not_introduce: a vendor-native work-unit contract that bypasses the adapter

stages.mechanism: Append-only ledger, at-least-once plus idempotent units, one winner on duplicate dispatch, in-flight work preserved when folding ad-hoc rails.
stages.proof_obligation: ledger seq is monotone; duplicate-dispatch winners==1; in-flight.dropped is empty; first ledger record has permission_ticket and via_adapter true.
stages.proof_predicate: ledger seqs == [1,2] AND duplicate-dispatch.json.winners==1 AND in-flight.json.dropped==[] AND ledger[0].via_adapter is true AND ledger[0].permission_ticket startswith a7-single-choke
rollback_commands: test "$HEAD_STAGE" = "S6" || (echo "revert later stacked PRs first; tip is not S6" && exit 1)
stages.pr_title: A9 S6: land runtime ledger over adapter+evaluator, keep in-flight work
stages.must_not_introduce: a second completion reducer or a dispatch path around the adapter

stages.mechanism: One error-message contract (happened / means / next_action) and aliases that resolve only to registry ids. Does not own capability identity.
stages.proof_obligation: error-contract samples include happened, means, next_action; every alias target is a registry id; control-planes table still has exactly one authority per row.
stages.proof_predicate: all(samples have happened,means,next_action) AND all(aliases.values() in registry ids) AND all(len(authorities per capability_class)==1)
rollback_commands: test "$HEAD_STAGE" = "S7" || (echo "revert later stacked PRs first; tip is not S7" && exit 1)
stages.pr_title: A9 S7: land the product error contract last, aliases to registry ids only
stages.must_not_introduce: a UX-owned second catalog or a second error contract

subsystem-local error strings as a second contract

lockfile-pinned package state with publish_channel null under PR-ONLY
gateway indexes all, materializes selected; resident-set floor
append-only ledger; duplicate-dispatch one winner; in-flight preserved

rollback.unit: first stage boundary (S1 permission evaluator) as a stacked PR revert in a scratch clone
steps: 1. Create a throwaway git clone (mktemp). Do not git-mutate the delivery worktree.
3. Copy S1 hybrid/permission-evaluator.json and siblings; commit as 'PR S1'.
4. Record PRE_STAGE_TREE as git -C "$CLONE" rev-parse HEAD^{tree} on the baseline commit, then confirm the S1 commit changed the tree.
6. Assert hybrid/permission-evaluator.json is absent and HEAD^{tree} equals the baseline tree.
forbids: canary or marketplace deploy as a stage boundary
git revert/reset/checkout on the delivery worktree /opt/p2/ast-integrate
adding opaque_body to the A2 registry to skip A1 remainder
picking a winner if two scratch-clone tree-equality readings disagree
